questions.q: Why did Mr. Barry buy Black Beauty?
choices: His doctor advised him to take horse exercise
He wanted to start his own cab business
He wanted to race him at the country fairs
He needed a strong horse for his new farm
questions.evidence: His doctor advised him to take horse exercise

questions.q: What was Mr. Barry like as a master?
choices: He was kind but knew very little about horses
He was cruel and used the whip on every ride
He was an expert horseman who had raced for years
He never rode Beauty and left him to the groom
questions.evidence: My master knew very little about horses, but he treated me well

questions.q: What was missing from Beauty's food?
choices: Most of his oats
All of his hay
His clean water
His beans and bran
questions.evidence: certainly not more than a quarter of what there should have been

questions.q: What excuse had the groom given Mr. Barry for Beauty being dull and weak?
choices: Horses are always dull and weak in the autumn
Beauty was getting old and would soon be done
Beauty was being ridden far too fast and far
The hay was poor this year after the wet spring
questions.evidence: horses are always dull and weak in the autumn

questions.q: Why did the gentleman farmer say "Autumn, fiddlesticks!"?
choices: It was only August, so the excuse made no sense
He had always hated the autumn and its weather
He thought Beauty was ill and needed a farrier
He wanted Mr. Barry to sell Beauty to him cheap

questions.q: How were the oats being taken each morning?
choices: Filcher's boy carried them off in a covered basket
Rats were creeping into the corn bin each night and eating them
Filcher sold them himself at the Saturday market
A cab horse in the next stall was eating them
questions.evidence: a little boy, who always had a covered basket with him

questions.q: When the police came, Filcher "blustered a good deal." What does "blustered" mean here?
choices: Talked loudly and angrily
Cried quietly to himself
Ran away as fast as he could
Laughed and made jokes
questions.evidence: though he blustered a good deal they walked him off

questions.q: What happened to Filcher in the end?
choices: He was sentenced to prison for two months
He was let go with only a warning
He was made head groom in the end
He paid Mr. Barry back and kept his place
questions.evidence: the man was sentenced to prison for two months
